prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1140; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end collision sustained while turning left, with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash. The mechanism and force of impact reported are in keeping with the injury pattern documented. Over the course of 28 visits, care consisted of spinal manipulation, therapeutic exercise, and soft tissue techniques, following a typical progression. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Physical examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, supporting the clinical diagnosis, while neurological screening and reflex testing were within normal limits. The patient also reported a remote, minor strain to the same region years earlier, which had resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries.
